name: Google Flights Scraper
description: Google Flights scraper for Python and the command line: one-way and round-trip itineraries between two airports for your dates, with airline, departure and arrival times, duration, stops, price and CO2 estimate, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Google Flights itineraries between two airports
commands.description: Flight itineraries between two airports — airline, times, stops, price, emissions.

inputs.name: departure_id
inputs.description: Departure airport or city IATA code, e.g. JFK.

inputs.name: arrival_id
inputs.description: Arrival airport or city IATA code, e.g. LAX.

inputs.name: return_date
inputs.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD — omit for one-way.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Interface language, e.g. en, it, de.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many itineraries to deliver at most (1–30). You pay only for delivered itineraries.
